description: This file defines a subclass of android.content.SearchRecentSuggestionsProvider that sets up a content provider for managing search suggestions based on recent queries. It specifies an authority and mode for the suggestions database.

classes.name: SearchSuggestionSampleProvider
classes.description: A subclass of SearchRecentSuggestionsProvider that configures search suggestions with a specific authority and mode.

methods.name: SearchSuggestionSampleProvider
methods.description: Constructor that calls setupSuggestions with predefined authority and mode.
